explanation: The min/max mireds arguments are swapped when converting to Kelvin — since mireds and Kelvin are inversely related, `min_mireds` corresponds to the maximum Kelvin and `max_mireds` to the minimum Kelvin, so passing `color_temperature_mired_to_kelvin(self.max_mireds)` as the warm (low Kelvin) bound and `color_temperature_mired_to_kelvin(self.min_mireds)` as the cool (high Kelvin) bound likely inverts the warm/cool channel mapping in `color_temperature_to_rgbww`.
